label: AMS product models — ship Micro 70M + Hybrid 120M (ONNX/GGUF on disk = installed)

items.name: ASI AMS Micro 70M
items.hardwareHint: CPU / Pi / 8 GB laptop — no GPU required
items.obtainHint: Download via Settings → Models → Download, or: node scripts/install-ams-models.mjs --id ams-micro-70m (needs HF_TOKEN for gated repo). Product ONNX basename is ams-micro-70m.onnx (~68.15M params → brand 70M). Legacy HF/training name ams-micro-50m-ctx1024.onnx still matches via onnxWeightHints.
installSteps: Run node scripts/install-ams-models.mjs (or Download in Settings → Models).
Install places available .gguf or .onnx from HF into models/ams/ as ams-micro-70m.onnx (product basename).
Confirm status Installed via GET /api/models/ams or node scripts/verify-ams-gguf.mjs.
items.notes: Default intent / cascade router on loopback :7821. Classifier — not a full chat LLM. Ship ONNX: ams-micro-70m.onnx (FP32; ~68.15M → brand 70M). Matching ONNX marks installed (ONNX on disk); GGUF preferred when published (not installed until a real .gguf exists). Reference router is still Ollama/llama.cpp — ONNX is ready for a future ONNX hop. HF: https://huggingface.co/vvarghese/ams-micro-70m

items.name: ASI AMS Hybrid 120M
items.hardwareHint: Prefer 8+ GB system RAM; CPU OK
items.obtainHint: Download via Settings → Models → Download, or: node scripts/install-ams-models.mjs --id ams-hybrid-120m (needs HF_TOKEN for gated repo). Local ship uses ams-hybrid-120m.onnx (~116.07M params → brand 120M; training lineage was hybrid-q3x route — not a quant format). Never map Micro ONNX here.
installSteps: Run node scripts/install-ams-models.mjs --id ams-hybrid-120m (or Download in UI), or place ams-hybrid-120m.onnx under models/ams/.
Browse → Scan now; verify with scripts/verify-ams-gguf.mjs.
items.notes: Optional larger on-device router for longer notes. Product name ASI AMS Hybrid 120M; ONNX ams-hybrid-120m.onnx. Legacy showcase-132m / hybrid-q3x training stems map here (hints only). Never faked from Micro ONNX. GGUF recipe uninstalled until real file exists. HF: https://huggingface.co/vvarghese/ams-hybrid-120m

items.name: ASI AMS Agent Chat (~50–100M)
items.obtainHint: Hidden from ship AMS UI. Set ASI_AMS_SHOW_ADVANCED=1 to list. Recipe only until GGUF dropped in.
installSteps: Set ASI_AMS_SHOW_ADVANCED=1 to show in Models AMS UI.
Rename so the filename contains agent-chat or agentchat.
items.notes: Advanced / non-ship. Short specialist replies. Not in default AMS list.

items.name: Ultra gate ~1M
items.hardwareHint: Any device — experiments only; never the ship brain
items.obtainHint: Hidden from ship AMS UI. Set ASI_AMS_SHOW_ADVANCED=1 to list. Never used as the ship brain.
installSteps: Set ASI_AMS_SHOW_ADVANCED=1 to show in Models AMS UI.
Optional: place ultra-gate*.gguf under models/ams/ for experiments.
Scan to list as ams-gguf:… — do not assign as desk chat brain.
items.notes: Advanced / non-ship. Tiny edge gate for experiments. Never used as the ship brain.

items.name: ASI AMS Floppy (1MB / ESP32)
items.diskSizeHint: <1 MB hard cap (INT8 or lower) — design only until a real file exists
items.ramHint: MCU flash / optional PSRAM — see design brief
items.hardwareHint: ESP32 / similar MCU — future SKU; not installed; never the ship brain
items.obtainHint: FUTURE only. Hidden from ship AMS UI. Set ASI_AMS_SHOW_ADVANCED=1 to list. No HF weights yet — do not invent GGUF/ONNX. Design brief: Agentic Micro Slm Model/FLOPPY_ESP32_BRIEF.md
installSteps: Do not install — no published Floppy weights.
Set ASI_AMS_SHOW_ADVANCED=1 only to show the recipe row for planning.
When a real <1 MB artifact exists, place under models/ams/ with a floppy weightHint and Scan — never mark installed without that file.
items.notes: Advanced / future / non-ship. Same appendix class as Ultra gate + Agent Chat. TinyStories-style Floppy-Gate (± optional Floppy-Talk) for ESP32. Strict <1 MB weight file. Never ship picker. Never mark installed without a real file.
